summary: Security review found a release tag-push authentication regression and workflow-trust checker gaps that could accept unsafe permission, checkout, or indirect command changes.
validation: Hosted PR creation verified as draft #149
blockers: Release tag pushes need explicit temporary authentication after persist-credentials=false.
Trust checker must validate release permissions, every checkout, and actual PR make target commands rather than text/comments.
next_action: Fix the review findings in the implementation worktree and return to review.

issues.title: Tag pushes lose authentication with credential persistence disabled
issues.details: Release pushes tags with plain git push after checkout persist-credentials=false; use explicit temporary token auth and cleanup.

issues.title: Release permission map is not checked
issues.details: Trust checker must enforce exact release permissions and reject additional authority.

issues.title: Only first checkout is checked
issues.details: Require every checkout to disable credential persistence or reject multiple checkouts.

issues.title: PR command check is textual and bypassable
issues.details: Parse run steps and enforce actual make ci-pr target, rejecting indirect privileged ci invocation and comment-only matches.
